title: Algerian Crunchy Wrap
description: A tasty and crunchy wrap filled with unique Algerian flavors.
instructions: Cut the wrap into large pieces.
In a pan, heat the chermoula over medium heat.
Add the sliced green pepper and cook until tender.
Add the crunchy fried shallots and cook for 1 minute.
Place the wrap pieces on a baking sheet and bake for 5 minutes.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the chermoula mixture on the baked wrap pieces.
Top with crunchy lettuce, green pepper, and crunchy fried shallots.
